repairs.prompt: One accurate educational watercolor illustration of a DRAFTING COMPASS used to draw circles, on a plain white background. Two sturdy metal legs joined at an upper hinge and opened a little. Left leg ends in a sharp needle point. Right leg securely holds a small sharpened wooden pencil with exposed graphite tip, pointing downward. Fine adjustment screw between legs. Entire instrument fully visible with generous margins, isolated diagonally on blank paper. NO drawn circle, no drawn arc, no geometric markings, no text, no letters or numbers, no compass rose, no navigation instrument. Warm watercolor children's visual dictionary style, accurate simple mechanical structure.
repairs.reason: 初回はコンパスの針が円の中心でなく円周側にあり、描画の仕組みと合わなかった。
repairs.review: 上部の関節で開く二本の脚、一方の針ともう一方の固定された鉛筆、開き幅の調整ねじを確認。道具全体を示し、誤った描画途中の円を省いた。

repairs.prompt: One precise educational watercolor illustration of a MODERN JAPANESE SOROBAN abacus, white background, no text or numerals. Viewed nearly straight from above, horizontal wooden rectangular frame, a horizontal reckoning bar separating a narrow UPPER compartment and wider LOWER compartment. Exactly SEVEN vertical rods. On EACH of the seven rods exactly ONE bead above the horizontal bar and exactly FOUR beads below the bar. All seven rods have identical bead counts. Every bead has the traditional JAPANESE flattened DIAMOND / biconical shape: pointed edges on left and right in profile, NOT rounded sphere or oval Chinese beads. Dark brown polished wooden diamond beads. Whole frame fully visible, ample margins, clean construction, restrained realistic watercolor illustration suitable for child's dictionary. Count upper 7 beads total and lower 28 beads total, no extra beads, no decorative dots.
